answer.report_md: 本页需生成两幅独立图：八地区双柱图（柱外全标值、横向网格、下置图例）及两面板八序列年度折线图（共享图例、零线、负值、五年稀疏刻度），并排版标题、解释与来源。目标值虽均直接印在柱顶，仍须同时用地区和“Before redistribution/After redistribution”定位；最大障碍是原页没有数据表，而非10点刻度。折线年度点数按1980–2025估为46，终年略不确定。

components.evidence: Separate numbered headings read “Figure 2.13.” and “Figure 2.14.”
Two green and red bars sit side by side for each of eight regions.
“Before redistribution” and “After redistribution” appear in a legend beneath the bars.
The rotated axis reads “Top 10% average to bottom 50% average income”.
The income-comparison axis title runs vertically along the left side.
Every number is printed just above its bar.
Labels including “North America & Oceania” wrap across multiple lines.
Dashed horizontal gridlines cross the plot; no vertical gridlines are drawn.
The paragraph ends “Sources and series: wir2026.wid.world/methodology and Chancel and Piketty (2021).”
Two matching time-series panels are arranged side by side.
One eight-region legend spans beneath both panels.
The eight-region legend is positioned below both plots.
Panels are titled “Tax progressivity” and “Redistribution considering taxes and transfers”.
A darker dotted horizontal zero rule spans each panel.
Several left-panel lines fall below the zero rule, reaching near −20.
The axis title ends with “income ratio (%)”.
“Reduction in top 10% to bottom 50% income ratio (%)” is vertical at left.
Annual lines have intervening vertices, while ticks appear only at 1980, 1985, …, 2020.
Eight annual series run across 1980–2025 in each of two panels.
The paragraph ends “Sources and series: wir2026.wid.world/methodology and Fisher–Post and Gethin (2025).”
